manifest.label: shared_bounded
manifest.scope: One fresh native legacy-quadratic JoinSplit proof from the fixed demo witness; independent CPU verifier and public-input tamper rejection.
manifest.timing: Native ABI proving call plus GPU drain; excludes context initialization, buffer setup, file output and independent CPU audit.

timer_definitions.four: Four existing wallet inputs, three fresh recursive proofs. Prover adapter timer includes setup, proving, in-process verification and serialization; excludes GPU initialization, original wallet production and independent CPU audit.
timer_definitions.single: Eight existing wallet inputs, seven fresh recursive proofs. Whole worker launch-to-exit window, including initialization, in-process verification, serialization and shutdown; excludes independent CPU audit.
timer_definitions.concurrent: Two independent eight-input jobs, sixteen input wallet proofs and fourteen fresh recursive proofs. Cohort launch-to-last-exit window; two Rayon threads per worker. This is not one sixteen-input aggregation tree.
timer_definitions.wallet: Fresh native JoinSplit proof for a fixed witness. Native proving call and GPU drain, including ABI serialization; excludes GPU initialization, buffer setup, artifact writes and independent CPU audit.

interpretation: Final qualification uses five alternating pairs for each aggregation workload and twenty native-wallet pairs, chosen before measurements. Every sample is retained.
Component timings are GPU event durations. They do not establish complete-prover speedup; the small-shape extension ran alongside a CPU release build.
The shared prototype fell back to the uncached kernel at 1024x3 with inverse scaling. Integrated dispatch preserves the existing cached fallback when the extra local storage does not fit.

Selected dispatch requires the V100 default or explicit research selection, at least 16384 rows and 16 columns or 262144 rows and 3 columns, and successful admission within the existing dynamic local-memory allowance.
The broad all-shape release build was retained as an experiment and superseded before proof qualification.
Recorded GPU event duration sums and nested host spans are nonadditive. Gaps between recorded events are not GPU-idle measurements.
Host spans measure elapsed time; inclusive process CPU counters include driver threads. Independent worker device clocks are not merged.
Kernel resource queries do not measure hardware occupancy or bandwidth saturation.
NVML energy covers the whole board over the worker/cohort window, not the whole system or one concurrent worker.
Warmups, profiles and controlled cache runs are outside qualification medians. Profiling and normal driver-cache entries are warmed separately.
The controlled cache comparison has one first-use and one repeated sample per variant.

Proof profiles, verifier, RNG batching, hiding, witness fusion and managed global allocation plans are preserved. Apple hardware and production/full-block delivery are not qualified by these measurements.
